operations.description: Nominal camera lengths. Diffraction acquired by summing without drift correction. Fixed spot size/C2 excitation keeps convergence constant; small-angle stigmation adjusted for round beam. Native real-space lattice spacing calibrates small-angle camera length. MoO3 standard determines wide-angle rotation; real-space images determine small-angle rotation.

operations.description: ImageJ bilinear rotation; GMS3.0 crop to 2^n x2^n pixels and apply 2D Hanning window. Log FT modulus displayed with fire LUT. DiffTools radial/azimuthal integrations. Autocorrelations calculated from raw TEM or STEM-EDS maps; TEM normalized to first Γ–M ([112̅0]SL) peak, EDS to central peak excluding origin. ImageJ linecuts along Γ–M. These are data-analysis operations, not new synthesized samples.
